prompt: A transversal crosses two parallel lines. Two of the angles formed lie BETWEEN the parallel lines and on OPPOSITE sides of the transversal. What are this pair of angles called?
hint: Read the description one word at a time: "between the lines" tells you interior or exterior.

hints.text: Read the description one word at a time: "between the lines" tells you interior or exterior.
"Opposite sides of the transversal" is exactly what the word "alternate" means.
Between the lines plus opposite sides means alternate interior angles.

explanation: "Interior" means between the two parallel lines; "exterior" means outside them.
"Alternate" means the two angles are on opposite sides of the transversal; "same-side" (co-interior) means the same side.
Between the lines and on opposite sides is the definition of alternate interior angles, and when the lines are parallel they are congruent.

alternativeExplanations.title: Build the name from two questions
steps: Question 1: inside or outside the parallel lines? Inside → "interior."
Question 2: same side of the transversal, or opposite sides? Opposite → "alternate." Put them together: alternate interior.
